Subject: Intro + quick scheduling ask — Summit Retail (self-serve sign-up)

Hi Marissa / Ben / Lisa —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood, Lisa — great to see Summit Retail exploring our inference platform. Quick handoff: Lisa indicated during the form that they want a short walkthrough of the product with both an AE (Ben) and SE (Karthik), and that IT/security will attend to validate data handling and SOC2 controls.

Lisa, Per your note that mornings in UK/Europe are best for IT, I flagged that to Ben — we should propose a couple of cross-geo slots and include the security checklist so your team can pre-scan. I attached the Redwood security checklist and a basic SOW template for context.

Proposed next steps:
- Ben: share 2–3 meeting times that cover US mornings and UK mid-afternoon (to accommodate both teams)
- Karthik: be prepared to cover integration patterns and data residency
- Lisa / IT: confirm availability and any pre-reqs (audit reports, IP allowlist)

Thanks — I’ll leave orchestration to Ben and Marissa.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
SDR, Redwood Inference

I’m Ben (AE) — happy to run a 45-minute demo and Q&A. I’ll have Karthik join to walk through integration and infra details for your IT/security team. To cover both US and UK participants, would any of these work? I’ve listed them with local times: 

Option A — Wed Sep 29 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 BST (45 min)
Option B — Thu Sep 30 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 16:00 BST (45 min)
Option C — Thu Sep 30 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET / 19:00 BST (30–45 min, if IT prefers later)

If none are good, tell me a morning UK window and we’ll move to accommodate. I’ll send a calendar invite once we lock a slot.

Agenda (proposed):
- 20 min product walkthrough (generation, routing, and private deployment options)
- 15 min SE deep-dive (data residency, logging, audit hooks)
- 10 min next steps / mutual action items

—

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick coordination. A couple of items from security:
- We prefer mornings BST (09:00–12:00) for these calls so we can triage and follow up during the same day.
- Please share SOC 2 section or an attestation and a short runbook for network allowlisting.
- We typically constrain demos that include PII; confirm what sample data you’ll use.

Can you share the Redwood checklist referenced and propose a 30–45 minute slot in the morning (BST) on Thu Sep 30? If you can’t do a morning BST time, our lead will need to dial in from a different timezone and approval will take longer.

Thanks,
IT Security Team
Summit Retail

Hi — thanks for the details. Attaching the Redwood Security Checklist (redwood highlights SOC2, encryption, key management, and retention) and a short allowlist guide. We will only demonstrate with synthetic/sample data — no customer PII. 

To accommodate BST morning preference, two morning-BST options that still work for our AE/SE are: 
- Thu Sep 30 08:00 PT / 11:00 ET / 16:00 BST (45 min)
- Thu Sep 30 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 BST (30–45 min)

If you confirm one of those two, Ben and Karthik will lock the invite. If you need an earlier BST slot (09:00 BST or earlier), note that would be late evening PT for us — we can still support it but would prefer the 16:00 BST/17:00 BST windows for full SE coverage.

Also: if there are specific artifacts you want (SOC2 report copy or subprocessor list), tell us and we’ll route a secure link.

Thanks,
